claims.statement: Rev. William Jones said that at 16 he was a prize fighter, backed as a boy wonder in the ring by Tom Allen of St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: At the age of 16 he was a prize fighter, being backed as a boy wonder inthe ring by Tom Allen of St. Louis.

notes: Allen appears only as the backer of Rev. Wm. Jones, recounted in a sermon-notice story about Mrs. Woodworth. Jones's date of boyhood fights is not given.
